attestations.text: Chu Shih-chieh 朱世傑 (T. 漢卿, H. 松庭), a native of Chihli and a teacher of mathematics at Yangchow about the year 1300. He left an elementary textbook entitled 算學啟蒙 Suan-hsüeh chi-mêng, 3 chüan, printed in 1299 (and later recovered from a Korean exemplar); and an algebra, entitled 四元玉鑑 Ssŭ-yüan yü-chien, 3 chüan, with a preface dated 1303.
